Card Q&A.a: No, it doesn't activate. "Attack with this Digimon" effects aren't suspending by an effect, they're suspending by an attack. Therefore, they aren't considered to be a "When an effect suspends" effect.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect activate when an attack is performed using a "[Start of Your Main Phase] Attack with this Digimon" effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends one of your Digimon, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
